instructionEnglish: The following statements are related to your work situation and how you experience this situation. Please state how often each statement applies to you.

items.sourceEnglish: At work, I feel mentally exhausted
items.platformEnglish: At work, I feel mentally exhausted

items.sourceEnglish: Everything I do at work requires a great deal of effort
items.platformEnglish: Everything I do at work requires a great deal of effort

items.platformEnglish: At work, I feel physically exhausted

items.platformEnglish: I want to be active at work, but somehow, I am unable to manage
